title: Penthouse Magazine October 1986 Complete w/ Centerfold College Football Coeds
conditionDescription: Vintage 1986 issue. Covers bright with light scuffing and small white wear marks on the black front cover, mostly near the edges; light edge wear on the spine. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, October 1986 issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Special readers' photo issue; Why Older Men Attract Coeds; 20 Worst College Football Teams; Divorce Without the Anguish.

Back cover: Lucky Strike Lights cigarette ad ("Light my Lucky").

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
